question: Team ES2011 played with fruit and vegetable ideas for the look of their remote. What did they decide about fruit and vegetable shapes in the end, and why?
answer: They ultimately dropped the idea of giving the remote many different fruit/vegetable shapes and favored the broccoli shape, with fruit identity expressed through colors or printed designs instead. Comfort was a concern with awkward shapes, and they said irregular/different shapes could cost more to produce; Speaker B acknowledged they had made the shapes mainly for fun with play-dough.
